name: PanelKind
author: sassify

sections.description:
PanelKind helps website teams create clear WordPress workspaces for their clients while protected agency owners retain full administration.

  • Create reusable Views, customise the Full administration View, and assign Views to native or custom roles.
  • Keep client workspaces free of automatic PanelKind credits.
  • Rename, reorder and hide admin navigation without changing post types or site content.
  • Build dashboards with welcome, information, quick-action, recent-content, overview, checklist and support widgets.
  • Create private information pages with role-based audiences and visual rich-text editing using WordPress’s editor and media library.
  • Create custom roles linked to existing native permission bases. Only agency owners can change native roles.
  • Configure role-based Allow, Deny and Inherit rules and mandatory site restrictions. WordPress’s native capabilities are always required.
  • Apply twelve colour themes or your own colours, logo, spacing, sidebar width, icons and interface cleanup.
  • Save drafts, review and publish changes, restore revisions and download signed same-site backups.
  • Preview real admin screens as a role or user with a persistent Exit preview control and saving blocked.
  • Retain owner recovery and stale-write protection.

All features included in this download work without payment, an account or a license. There are no commercial item-count quotas. Technical validation limits protect against oversized configurations. PanelKind currently supports single-site WordPress, PHP 8.0 or newer and WordPress 6.6 or newer. Activation does not change existing users’ workspaces until you publish assignments.

Optional PanelKind Pro

This plugin shows only its available features. Its settings include an optional PanelKind Pro panel with a purchase link; Pro-only controls and implementations are not included in this download. Pro adds individual user assignments and access exceptions, individual content audiences, Section Sidebars with separate dashboards and nested navigation, reusable View templates, portable imports and exports, custom corners and shadows, and custom footer text.

Purchase Pro at panelkind.byteflowsoftware.co.uk. Download its ZIP from your purchase account, upload it and activate it. Pro automatically deactivates Free and keeps your saved workspaces, drafts, roles and permissions. Activate your license inside Pro. A license key alone cannot add Pro functionality to this Free download.

Developed by Byteflow Software.

External services

This Free edition does not include Freemius, send telemetry or contact a licensing server. The Purchase PanelKind Pro link opens https://panelkind.byteflowsoftware.co.uk only when you choose it. Purchases and the separate Pro plugin use Freemius; those services are documented in Pro. Free updates use WordPress.org’s standard update mechanism.

Development

The editable source is included in this download: panelkind.php, includes/.php, assets/admin.js, assets/client.js, assets/preview.js and assets/.css. These JavaScript and CSS files are the human-readable source executed directly by WordPress, not minified or compiled bundles. There is no separate source map, npm dependency, compilation or build step required to modify or run this plugin. Edit the included files directly and reload the browser. See SOURCE.txt for the source inventory and instructions. WordPress supplies the editor, media library and Dashicons; this download bundles no third-party JavaScript libraries.
sections.installation:
1. Install PanelKind from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload panelkind-free-1.8.2.zip through Plugins > Add Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate as the administrator who will be the initial agency owner.
  3. Open PanelKind. Its four main sections are Roles & Permissions, Dashboard Widgets, Informational Pages and Admin Styling.
  4. Edit a View, configure role assignments and access rules, then save a draft.
  5. Preview your draft as a role or user. Exit preview, review the publication impact and publish.

To upgrade to Pro, upload panelkind-pro-1.8.2.zip, activate it and enter your purchased license in Pro. You do not need to uninstall Free first. If you delete the inactive Free edition while Pro is active, the shared configuration is preserved.
sections.faq:
Is this a trial?

No. The included Free features do not expire and have no commercial usage quotas. All included functionality is available without a license. Additional functionality is implemented in the separate Pro download.

Does hiding a menu protect its page?

No. Navigation visibility and access rules are separate. Use Deny to restrict supported resources. An Allow rule never grants a missing native WordPress capability. Powerful administrators may still be able to deactivate the plugin; use appropriately limited native roles for clients.

Are all third-party plugin actions protected?

No. Discovered third-party screens are labelled Screen only. Their separate REST, AJAX or admin-post handlers need native capability checks and a tested adapter. Custom post types sharing core capabilities may share those restrictions. PanelKind does not claim universal protection of third-party endpoints.

Who can read private information pages and widgets?

Signed-in users must pass the content audience and access checks. Owners and managers explicitly granted content-management permission can edit managed content. Export permission authorises access to full configuration backups, including private content, and should be assigned carefully. A View-only manager receives content references without private titles or bodies. Managers can inspect access decisions without rendering another user’s private content.

Pages have no public post type, feed, sitemap or public REST route. Linked WordPress uploads can still have public URLs; PanelKind does not provide protected file delivery.

How does preview work?

Only agency owners can start content previews. The selected role or user cannot exceed the owner’s native permissions. Preview opens actual WordPress admin screens under the selected identity, blocks form saves, REST writes and non-read AJAX requests, and guards database writes. Temporary editor auto-drafts are removed on exit or scheduled cleanup. Original authentication cookies are retained, and preview expires after one hour.

Role preview uses your account’s content ownership with the selected role’s capabilities; user preview uses the selected user’s ownership. Third-party callbacks run during preview. Screens requiring writes to render may not work; filesystem changes, external service calls and persistent-cache effects are outside the database guard.

What happens when I change editions?

Activating Pro deactivates Free and preserves shared data. Free cannot be activated over an active Pro edition. Before moving a previously configured Pro site back to Free, remove Pro-only settings using Pro. Free rejects incompatible activation and keeps the saved data. If files are replaced without activation checks, unsupported access policies block client resources until Pro is restored, rather than silently weakening restrictions. Owner and profile recovery access remains available.

What happens on uninstall?

Deactivation retains settings. Uninstall removes management grants and temporary preview sessions. Configuration is retained unless Delete plugin configuration when uninstalling was explicitly enabled. Uninstall never removes users or ordinary site content. Assigned and default custom roles retain their last native capabilities; unused plugin-created roles are removed only with deletion enabled. Deleting an inactive edition while another edition is active preserves shared data and grants.

How do I recover access?

Agency owners retain native full administration. Use Activity & recovery for temporary safe mode or stale-lock recovery. Temporarily setting PANELKIND_RECOVERY_MODE to true in wp-config.php bypasses workspace restrictions; remove it after repair. WP-CLI users can run wp panelkind recover. Legacy wp adminer recover remains an alias.

Can I update an older WP Adminer installation?

The legacy commercial upgrade ZIP retains the wp-adminer folder. The directory edition uses panelkind. Do not replace a Pro-configured legacy installation with Free without reviewing edition compatibility. Version 1.8.2 imports legacy configuration, revisions, drafts, role definitions, management grants, checklist progress and activity into the panelkind_ storage prefix. Existing custom role IDs and memberships remain intact. Back up your site before updating. Custom integrations must use the panelkind/v1 REST namespace, panelkind_* hooks and capabilities, PanelKind PHP namespace and PANELKIND_* constants. Use matching 1.8.2-or-newer Free and Pro editions when switching; older Pro builds use the previous storage names.

Is the interface translated?

The management interface is currently English, with RTL layout support. PHP strings use the panelkind text domain and WordPress translations where available.
sections.changelog:
1.8.3

  • Support PHP 8.0 and newer.

1.8.2

  • Add an optional Pro purchase panel describing the separate paid download.
  • Exclude licensing and entitlement classes and Pro-only stylesheets from Free.

1.8.1

  • Introduce a directory edition containing only working Free features and an optional website link to the separate Pro download.
  • Remove Pro-only settings, paid-action handlers and quota prompts from the Free editor.
  • Provide unrestricted colour reset and a dedicated access inspector.
  • Preserve configuration and deactivate Free when Pro is activated.
  • Restrict delegated configuration reads and preserve hidden fields during saves.
  • Separate permission inspection from owner-only content rendering.
  • Escape component output and validate routing selectors.
  • Preserve checklists, rich content, styling and native editor workflows.
  • Remove preview sessions on uninstall and protect shared data when deleting an inactive edition.
